name: Bahamas Rum Cake Factory
primary_cta: Add to bag (cart drawer) then 'Checkout on thebahamasrumcakefactory.com' via a real Shopify cart permalink with their variant IDs; six-pack builder; visit the East Bay Street shop
brand_truth: One recipe, one downtown Nassau shop since 2000, now the Official Rum Cake of The Bahamas.
buyer: Cruise passengers deciding today on a phone downtown, and US gift buyers reordering online.

direction.why: Their own studio photos give every flavour its own colour; a colour poster that changes with the flavour is the product truth and the most appetising thing they own.

big_idea: Pick a flavour and the whole first screen turns that flavour's colour, with their own studio photo, the real price and Add to bag.
concept_type: webshop: catalogue + six-pack builder + cart drawer + checkout hand-off to their Shopify
tier_why: Their own product photography and colour does the work; no 3D.

plan_gate.verdict: revise x5, applied (phone chip rail directly under the photo, wider soft edge fade and phone edge masks, desktop chips in two centred rows, six-pack packshot and tinted dashed slots, flavour name in display type in the price card)

current_site_findings: Old listings still point to bacardirumcake.com
Shop address and opening times are not prominent
Stock-named (AdobeStock) images used as product photos
Long repeated product grids on mobile
pitch_line: Your studio photos already give every flavour its own colour; this shop lets a cruise passenger pick one, watch the page turn Key Lime green, and check out in your existing Shopify cart.
assumptions: Street address 602 East Bay Street and phone (242) 328-3750 from Yelp; the record says McPherson St
Opening times (7:30 am Mon to Sat, 8 am Sun) from Yelp; closing time unknown
Cart permalink note parameter carries the six-pack flavours; confirm the Mix and Match product accepts flavours by note
Ground colours sampled from their photos
notes: Gen-2 rebuild by scheduled site worker 2026-11-21. Audit filled: real Shopify webshop (priority C), so the concept is a shop with a real cart hand-off. Every product, price and sold-out state comes from products.json. Photos viewed through a Lovable viewer project (ip-assets-rum-cake-factory, 3 rounds: flavours, shop photos, catalogue thumbnails); beauty products carry the Emporium de Coconut brand as sold in their store. BLIND: screenshots used crops of the viewer screenshots. Plan-gate critic asked for 5 revisions, applied; scores are its predicted post-fix scores. qa: 0 blockers (tap warning is the shared concept-label button). distinct: distinct (closest 55).
